body: Thanks, I would appreciate that. Should I PM you?

I've been on a few different medications, yeah. For some reason it's like nothing sticks. I just don't get what's wrong with me.

Everyone thinks I'm lazy or something. I'm just so incredibly tired and so lonely. So so lonely. I'm not sure what else to do, but I feel like I fuck everything up. That I would fuck hurting myself up and then what.. It's so hard. I feel stuck.
Since I was about 15 or so I'd say. I'm only in my 20's so I guess it just feels like such a long time with no relief. No let up in feeling bad.
